extraction.name: LongBench
extraction.description: A bilingual, multi-task benchmark for long context understanding, comprising 21 datasets across 6 task categories in both English and Chinese, with an average length of 6,711 words (English) and 13,386 characters (Chinese).
extraction.creator: Yushi Bai, Xin Lv, Jiajie Zhang, Hongchang Lyu, Jiankai Tang, Zhidian Huang, Zhengxiao Du, Xiao Liu, Aohan Zeng, Lei Hou, Yuxiao Dong, Jie Tang, Juanzi Li
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Data collection involves extracting from existing datasets (e.g., NarrativeQA, Qasper, HotpotQA), manual curation (MultiFieldQA), and creation of synthetic tasks (PassageRetrieval, PassageCount). For MultiFieldQA, documents are collected from multiple sources including legal documents, government reports, encyclopedias, academic papers, etc.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis, Manual Human Curator, Web Scraping, Web API
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Raw data sources include: Literature and film (NarrativeQA), scientific articles (Qasper), Wikipedia (HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, MuSiQue), Baidu Search and Baidu Zhidao (DuReader), government reports (GovReport), meetings (QMSum, VCSUM), news (MultiNews), web questions (TREC), dialogue (SAMSum), GitHub (LCC, RepoBench-P), C4 Dataset (PassageRetrieval-zh).
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: For multi-document QA, complete Wikipedia passages are used as context, with supporting and distracting passages added and randomly ordered. For DuReader, 20 documents per question are associated, including distractors. For synthetic tasks, passages are randomly sampled, repeated, and shuffled.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Datasets are standardized into a unified format. For LongBench-E, uniform sampling based on length is performed to create an even length distribution. To avoid test leakage, data is extracted from test sets of public datasets, with random or uniform sampling strategies.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: For MultiFieldQA, three Ph.D. students annotate questions and answers for each article, ensuring answers are inferable from documents and evidence placement is random. Annotation guidelines require clear questions with definitive answers and varied question types.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Cross-validation among annotators for MultiFieldQA shows a 100% accuracy rate of the annotated answers.
extraction.rai:annotationsPerItem: For MultiFieldQA, each data sample is annotated by three Ph.D. students.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: Ph.D. students with extensive research experience in NLP.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: GPT-3.5-Turbo is used for summarization in synthetic tasks (PassageRetrieval).
extraction.rai:dataBiases: During annotation for MultiFieldQA, placement of evidence is made fairly random to avoid biases if answer-related statements are frequently found at the beginning or end.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Potentially unreliable automatic metrics (ROUGE-L, F1) may not accurately reflect response quality, and performance is coupled with models' instruction-following capabilities.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation for evaluating long context understanding in LLMs. Usage includes single-doc QA, multi-doc QA, summarization, few-shot learning, synthetic tasks, and code completion.
